create_split_generator: create a SplitGenerator with name and gen_kwargs for a dataset builder split
build_split_dict: build a SplitDict from a list of SplitInfo objects using from_split_dict
merge_dataset_splits: merge two NamedSplit objects using the add operator to combine train and test splits
